'''Seltaya Major''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
Riddled with cave systems, [[Safonne Pendon]] maintained a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pendon's pirates|fleet]] there that targeted [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships.

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] placed the system in the Expansion Region, [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] mentioned a planet called Seltaya and placed it in the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Both sources described Seltaya as an ice world and homebase to a group of pirates. This contradiction was solved with the publication of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the Seltaya from ''Wanted by Cracken'' to be Seltaya Major in the [[Seltaya Major system/Legends|Seltaya Major system]] and Seltaya from ''Twin Stars of Kira'' to be Seltaya Minor (or Ropagi III) in the [[Ropagi system/Legends|Ropagi system]].<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31413670|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-12-04|time=7:31 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802122715/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-157}}</ref>
